reproduced_candidate_gap.name: bounded stale replay fingerprint ring can forget old exact requests
reproduced_candidate_gap.risk: after more than 32 later durable requests in one segment, a delayed exact retry can fall out of stale_replay_fingerprints; the existing history_rewritten path can then re-enter provider planning and potentially repeat a previously issued tool action

candidate_fix.rule_normal_turn: for same model and outside the post-compaction transition, a shorter incoming input_fingerprints tuple that is a strict prefix of the latest durable tuple fails closed before provider planning
candidate_fix.rule_compaction: a shorter compaction history that is a strict prefix of the latest durable tuple fails closed before provider planning
candidate_fix.why_content_free: uses only existing SHA-256 input fingerprints; stores no additional prompt, answer, tool arguments, or user text
